name: upsale
description: UPSale - MERN stack with Next.js, NestJS, and MongoDB

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w admin
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start -w frontend" "npm run start -w admin"
scripts.start:all: concurrently "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend" "npm run start -w admin"
